module: Data module for genericGauges (type "auxiliary"): provides the vehicle sensor's accelerations. To be referenced in displayData.customModules with the module name accelerationData.
notes: The units are those of sensors.gx/gy/gz (not specified in this file).

updateGFX.desc: Does nothing (the update is done by updateGaugeData).

setupGaugeData.desc: Called by genericGauges with the properties requested in displayData.customModules: acceleration (x, y, z = sensors.gx/gy/gz) and accelerationSmooth (xSmooth, ySmooth, zSmooth = sensors.gx2/gy2/gz2).

properties.desc: Set of requested properties (key = name, value = true).

updateGaugeData.desc: Called by genericGauges before each send: fills moduleData with the requested values.

moduleData.desc: Module data table, then sent to the HTML page.

dt.desc: Time elapsed since the last send (s).
